title: 互感电压与耦合系数
statement: 正弦电流源 İs = 2∠0° A（有效值），ω = 50 rad/s，从同名端（•）流入线圈 L1。L1 = 0.2 H，L2 = 0.8 H，互感 M = 0.2 H，线圈 L2 开路（c、d 两端不接负载）。
取 U̇1 = U̇_a（L1 两端电压，a 端为 +），U̇2 = U̇_cd（L2 两端电压，c 端为 +），a、c 都在同名端一侧。求 U1、U2 的有效值和 U̇2 的相位，并判断耦合系数 k。

questions.ask: L1 两端电压有效值 U1 = ?
questions.explain: L2 开路，İ2 = 0，L1 上只有自感电压：U̇1 = jωL1·İs = j10 × 2 = j20 V，U1 = 20 V。
L2 中没有电流，只有互感电压：U2 = ωM·Is = 50 × 0.2 × 2 = 20 V。
电流从 L1 的同名端流入，在 L2 上产生的互感电压以 L2 的同名端为正：U̇2 = jωM·İs = 20∠90° V，超前 İs 90°。

questions.ask: 两线圈的耦合系数 k = ?

hints: L2 开路，所以 İ2 = 0：L1 上只有自感电压，L2 上只有互感电压。
互感电压 U̇2 = jωM·İ1，其“+”在与 İ1 流入端互为同名端的那一端。
solution: **2. 线圈方程。** U̇1 = jωL1·İ1 + jωM·İ2，U̇2 = jωM·İ1 + jωL2·İ2（两电流都从同名端流入，电压以同名端为正）。L2 开路，İ2 = 0，İ1 = İs = 2∠0° A。

en.title: Mutual voltage and the coupling coefficient
statement: A sinusoidal current source Is = 2∠0° A (rms), ω = 50 rad/s, drives current into the dotted (•) terminal of coil L1. L1 = 0.2 H, L2 = 0.8 H, mutual inductance M = 0.2 H; coil L2 is open (nothing is connected across c–d).

Let U1 = U_a (the voltage across L1, + at a) and U2 = U_cd (the voltage across L2, + at c); a and c are on the dotted side. Find the rms values of U1 and U2, the phase of U2, and the coupling coefficient k.

questions.explain: L2 is open, so I2 = 0 and L1 carries only its self-induced voltage: U1 = jωL1·Is = j10 × 2 = j20 V, U1 = 20 V.
No current flows in L2, so its voltage is purely mutual: U2 = ωM·Is = 50 × 0.2 × 2 = 20 V.
The current enters L1 at its dot, so the mutual voltage in L2 is + at L2's dot: U2 = jωM·Is = 20∠90° V, leading Is by 90°.
k = M / √(L1·L2) = 0.2 / √(0.2 × 0.8) = 0.2 / 0.4 = 0.5. Always k ≤ 1; k = 1 means perfect coupling.

hints: L2 is open, so I2 = 0: L1 has only a self-induced voltage and L2 only a mutual voltage.
The mutual voltage is U2 = jωM·I1, positive at the terminal that corresponds (by the dots) to the terminal where I1 enters.
solution: **2. Coil equations.** U1 = jωL1·I1 + jωM·I2, U2 = jωM·I1 + jωL2·I2 (both currents entering the dots, voltages + at the dots). L2 is open, I2 = 0, and I1 = Is = 2∠0° A.
